title: salix japonica f. pygmaea
intro: Salix japonica f. pygmaea, commonly known as Japanese Dwarf Willow, is a small shrub or tree species in the Salicaceae family, typically found in East Asia. The health benefits of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. The therapeutic actions of Salix japonica f. pygmaea are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, ease pain, and lower fever, which are achieved through its bioactive constituents, including salicylic acid and flavonoids. Bioactive constituents present in Salix japonica f. pygmaea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and salicylic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
